script: Proxima Centauri is the closest star to the Sun. Even so, its light takes more than four years to reach us. The Voyager 1 probe would need more than 70,000 years to get there. Proxima is a small red dwarf, too dim to see without a telescope. It has at least one planet in the zone where water could be liquid. Follow WonderBytes for more facts that sound fake but are true.
